It’s just a simple algebra problem when Hero knows he needs to be right 25% of the time.

Villain only needs to be bluffing with 10 combos for Hero to call. But here’s the problem: all of the hands in Villain’s range have some sort of showdown value. J-10, 10-10, 10-9s, 9-8s, 8-8, 7-6s, 6-6, 5-5 and 5-4s can all beat overcards at showdown. As a result, it isn’t likely Villain would elect to bluff with any of these hands.

There are only two ways Hero can justify a call on this river. The first is if he thinks Villain’s check-calling range on the flop is significantly wider. That would open up potential bluffing opportunities on this river. The second is if he thinks Villain could be value-betting with worse and hoping to get called by ace high. That's highly unlikely on this board texture.
